answer_text: Slow performance can be caused by weak Wi‑Fi or routing issues. First, check your client’s Wi‑Fi signal; if it’s -75 dBm or worse, improving the Wi‑Fi signal often resolves slow client performance. If Wi‑Fi looks fine, run a quick ping and traceroute to compare latencies with and without the Cato path to identify sub-optimal routing. If the Internet problems persist, you can enable Recovery via Internet to automatically recover connectivity by routing through ISP links when Cato Cloud can't reach the Internet.
